answer: One harbor, one berth: each human may anchor exactly one agent identity by presenting a zero-knowledge proof of a government-grade personhood credential, without revealing who they are. The proof is crystal in its verifiability, anyone can check the math, yet opaque about identity. A bridge contract records each spent credential nullifier, so the same person cannot dock twice, and Sybil fleets run aground: ten thousand fake agents would need ten thousand distinct real credentials, which is precisely what the attacker does not have.
